item.title: SpaceX IPO ready for blastoff: Musk’s Mars Colony and the SpaceX IPO
item.description:
Elon Musk's space company made its IPO plans public...
Hello there. What’s a mention of AI that’s even less welcome than praising the tech at a college commencement? Saying that your company’s layoffs of thousands of people will replace “lower-value human capital” with AI, as Standard Chartered CEO Bill Winters recently learned. Winters urged employees in a memo yesterday not to be unsettled by “a quote taken out of context.” But it’s hard to imagine a context that makes this one better besides “say something that’s sure to make everyone mad.”

item.title: Elon loses it: OpenAI diaries and billionaire power struggles
item.description:
Musk's case against OpenAI got tossed...
Greetings earthling. If you felt a looming presence above you, it wasn’t your co-worker who’s always peeping at your screen. According to NASA, the recently discovered asteroid 2026JH2 passed close to Earth yesterday. While it was never near enough to threaten us with the fate of the dinosaurs, it did get within 24% of the average distance between the Earth and the moon—which is pretty darn close in celestial object terms. Missed it? 2026JH2 is expected to do another drive by in 2060, though it’ll be farther away then.

item.title: Second Acts Brew: Why Professionals Are Trading Desks For Trades
item.description:
More people are changing careers than ever...
Good morning. Are you currently daydreaming from your cubicle about quitting your corporate job to guide whale-watching boats in the Azores? Today’s newsletter is for you. We’ll tell you everything you need to know about changing careers, from who’s doing it (and why), to what pro athletes do for work when they hang up their cleats. We’ll also get into how AI is convincing many Americans to switch their collars from white to blue. Ross from Friends said it best: It’s time to pivot (careers).
https://www.morningbrew.com/issues/second-acts-brew
